connector.name: Numeratica - financial planning calculations
connector.registryDescription: Deterministic US financial planning: retirement Monte Carlo, Roth conversion, RMD, tax, IRMAA, SS
connector.summary: Hosted at api.numeratica.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.numeratica, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <your Numeratica API key>, from https://docs.numeratica.com/get-key. Required for every tools/call. Discovery (initialize, tools/list, ping) answers without it, so a registry can enumerate the catalogue, but a client should still collect the key at setup or the first tool call fails.

env.name: NUMERATICA_API_KEY
env.description: Numeratica API key (nmr_sk_...). Free self-serve key at https://docs.numeratica.com/get-key

env.name: NUMERATICA_BASE_URL
env.description: Override the API base URL. Defaults to https://api.numeratica.com; only needed for a staging or self-hosted deployment.

env.name: NUMERATICA_TIMEOUT_MS
env.description: Per-request timeout in milliseconds (default 120000, minimum 1000). Raise it for long-horizon Monte Carlo runs.
